messages.author: e14cfb57d640984d
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Error in ftwindow
parts:
"Blackman" doesn't appear to be a valid window function name. Try using "blackman" instead, all lower case.

You can get a complete list of available window functions with 

help(ftwindow)

best,
jesse
